blocks.text: This is the most important time in history as we near the soon return of our Lord Jesus Christ! – A space of time given for the world to repent; an hour to pray for our loved ones while they will listen for the time is coming where they will not endure sound doctrine, but give heed to seducing spirits. We’re living in a fast-paced world where a false prosperity is seducing young and old alike. Debt is swallowing up the nations to where they will “owe their soul to the company store” or World Bank. The anti-Christ will soon take control. We must work while we can to publish this gospel, the true message that Brother Neal Frisby gave the Elect and a witness to the world.

On Scroll #2 Brother Frisby wrote about William Branham: “Several times I was allowed to see and know of his death in advance. I knew a change of time and Ministry would unfold. All gifted men said he was a major prophet, although some did not agree with part of his message. One thing for certain we will do well to remember his death was for a sign. (The second anointing starts with judgment.) Few man have ever been favored to walk with God as he did.” End quote. Note: God always gives a double witness. The Elect will recognize this and be ready. Both these men were faithful witnesses. Their messages were to get the Bride ready and warn the world of God’s judgment. Major events are underway to change the very way of life on this earth. Energy will play a great part now and in the future. Matt. 25:10 shows a spiritual shortage of oil. Rev. 6:6 shows a natural shortage of resources, food, oil, etc., indicating strict control. For there must be famine as never before; a drought of great magnitude.

Last month we spoke about the weather and what a month! July set a record for tropical storms. The five tropical storms recorded in July were the most on record for that month and worldwide it was second warmest July on record, a U.S. Climate Center reported. – Also there were earthquakes and droughts. – Luke 21:10, 11.

The Bible speaks the truth. We are in an information age upon the earth in such a way that prophecy is fulfilling right before our eyes. The future is here now – prophecy fulfilled. A recent article revealing new weapons. One weapon is being deployed for crowd control. A ray gun type emitting microwave. It makes the crowds uncomfortable. This weapon is now being sent to Iraq. In the near future it will also be used to control world populations when needed.- New fighter planes unmanned with smart weapons of unlimited power capable of mass-destruction.

Now a quote from Neal Frisby – “ELECTRONIC WONDERS AND FUTURE WEAPONS COMING AS PREDICTED – Many things have been kept secret, but new and more powerful destructive weapons are being made and more are concealed on the drawing boards! Besides new type land vehicles like robotic tanks and sea submarines, also they can use high pitched sound waves to destroy the enemies minds at a far away distance! – Some of their new inventions will be almost like supernatural, but yet computerized, laser and electronics; also will use new magnetic rays and waves!” – For the rest of the quote, read Scroll #225.

This is an hour of great confusion. We are at the midnight hour. A time when many are falling fast asleep. This is the time to be very watchful for many important events are taking place, seen and unseen. A new religious and political system will arrive on the scene. Many times Brother Frisby told me that it would almost fool the very Elect. He said to me that it would be a Pentecostal-type spirit seemingly to know all things, but not the true word of God. As Eve was deceived by the serpent this spirit will try to deceive the Elect. But the Scripture says that it would almost deceive the elect, but will not. (Mark 13:22) Time will not permit me to say anymore about this subject, but will later.

This month we will send you a special writing called “Fire and Ice”. What you have given is never overlooked by the Lord Jesus and will bring blessings materially and spiritually! “Give… and thou shalt have treasure in heaven!” (Matt. 19:21) - Here is another encouraging Scripture… “Thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and thou shalt have good success!” (Josh. 1:8) - “And those that listen to the Lord and delight in His commandments, wealth and riches shall be in his house!” (Ps. 112:1-3).
The Lord will supply all of your needs and bless you. Our prayers are with you in this precious work of the Lord Jesus Christ. Your Brother In Christ,
